formalization_notes: Direct Core relations.
Role realization/playedBy is a foundational typing relation and must not be invented as a domain material relation.
IdentitySubject role realization is supplied by domain/profile rigid kinds; no new Core relation required.
Identifier target and scope are directly traceable.
Direct Claim semantics.
Evidence supporting AssuranceAssessment may be derived through proofing/trust provenance unless Wave 7 justifies a direct property.
Proof use is contextual; no essential Proof artifact relation is introduced.
Direct Credential provenance/content/status trace.
Timestamp and explicit status-transition result property belong to Wave 7 OWL/SHACL design if needed for executable CQ.
Direct proofing evidence/outcome relations.
Direct enrollment semantics.
IdentityBinding mediation and grounding are explicit.
Direct Authentication event trace.
Authenticator is roleMixin; role-player realization is foundational typing, not a new material relation.
Assurance dimension and level/value data properties/controlled values are Wave 7 formalization inputs.
Direct AuthorizationRequest kernel.
Two context types are independently traceable.
Evaluation and result relation explicit.
Permission/action/resource semantics explicit.
Validity interval may require temporal properties/SHACL in Wave 7.
Delegation scope may be represented through delegated permission/resource constraints in Wave 7.
Trust assessment hook is explicit.
Cross-context Trust Governance distinction is explicit.
Regression repair: nonexistent IdentityLink concept removed; account co-reference represented by governed linkedAccount relation without equality inference.
Session expiration/revocation lifecycle properties are Wave 7 extension constraints.
Issuer/holder/verifier and credential-subject separation explicit.
Workload subject/principal role realization remains foundational; representation/principal relations are profile governed.
Device subject/authenticator/principal role multiplicity is foundational role realization; no collapse relation is created.
AgentSponsor typo repaired; autonomous/delegated access trace explicit.
Government Identity and Trust Governance remain distinct contexts.
SocialLogin is a mapping-only bridge (CM4DI-MAP0018); SocialIdentity remains external. No ontology relation is required.
Comparative scenario CQ is evaluated through profile/domain composition and mappings rather than one ontology relation.

Source provenance and authority relations.

Permission bundle and grant relations.

Workload-to-managed representation and principal role trace.

Contextual role multiplicity evaluated through type assertions and role realization.

Framework participation/status trace.
